title: Gorenstein formal fibres of a local ring with a dualizing complex
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The argument reduces every formal fibre to the generic fibre of a domain quotient. It then tracks the dualizing complex through completion and fraction-field localization and proves the formal-fibre dualizing object is a shift of the unit. The compatibility of completion and the generic dualizing shift is a substantive structural obligation.
